title: Mech lifecycle: brought online once, boarded freely, spent for good
intent: Make the mech a single, run-scoped purchase that can never be bought, activated or rewarded twice

evidence.description: double tap charges 200 once, held E stays aboard, spent mech offers nothing, restart resets, no listener or body growth

constraints.statement: States are dormant, piloted, parked, depleted, destroyed; only dormant can be activated (200 coins, once per run) and only parked boarded (free); depleted and destroyed are final for the run
Activation and boarding go through the scene's one purchase path; interact ignores key repeats and climbOut refuses within 400 ms of boarding, so a held or double-tapped E never boards and climbs out
The mech is built in create() like every per-run object; a restart gives a dormant mech, closed gates and one visible player
